prerequisites: Basic knowledge from Production and Logistics

learning_outcomes.text: Students can apply the elements and methods of structured factory planning. They can use essential subtasks of factory planning as needed, e.g., factory analysis, site selection, building planning, layout planning and creation, planning of supply and disposal (material flow planning) as well as the linkage of production and logistics areas with each other and the integration into upstream and downstream process stages.
They are able to understand legal requirements, e.g., workplace regulations, operating procedures, occupational safety and others using concrete examples.

Students are able to carry out a factory planning project holistically and with appropriate resource deployment. They can technically and economically evaluate the necessary tasks and transfer the implementation of the required measures into a project plan.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of factory planning issues with a simulation program
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination. The grade's contribution to the final grade is determined according to the study and examination regulations (SPO).
